claim: BuildModel was run five times per variant
detail: 1 run-vector columns, every entry exactly 5 replicates

claim: Reference values are 2.9 kcal/mol for both stability axes and 3.5 for binding
detail: engine anchors equal the Methods values: {'monomer': 2.9, 'complex_context': 2.9, 'binding': 3.5}

claim: R is the largest energy ratio, not a sum of correlated effects
detail: calculate_isds_v1 uses max() and contains no sum()

claim: S = (E + C)/2, C maps Tiers 1-4 to 1, 2/3, 1/3, 0, and E = R/(1+R)
detail: S = (E+C)/2 holds on 49 rows; C lands on {1, 2/3, 1/3, 0}; E within [0,1)

claim: Experimental coordinates are not pLDDT-gated, and no variant is scored with every axis below the 50 admission floor
detail: status values ['confident', 'crystal', 'partial']; 30 crystal rows all at pLDDT 100; 31 non-crystal variants all with a best pLDDT at or above the 50 floor (min 68.5)

claim: The isolated subunit is a separate single-chain model, not a chain extracted from the complex
detail: 13 variants pair an experimental complex (1JM7.pdb, 2HHB.pdb, 6XI7.pdb) with an AlphaFold monomer, which chain extraction cannot produce

claim: Only the BRCT, VWF A1 and complement factor H systems use an experimental monomer chain
Unknown or inapplicable axes are omitted from grading
detail: 2 variants excluded by curated role, none of them graded

claim: Both reverse-direction benign controls predict below 0.72 kcal/mol on every axis
detail: largest absolute predicted energy across both controls: 0.714 kcal/mol

claim: The prioritization population is 46 variants: 21 positive, 25 negative
detail: 46 = 21 positives + 25 negatives, as the Methods states

claim: Six HBB variants use mature-chain numbering (E6V, i.e. p.Glu7Val)
detail: 6 HBB variants, E6V present under mature-chain numbering

claim: The absence of an assay was never treated as evidence
detail: 18 axes rest on a basis admitting no axis assay; every one of them is neutral

claim: Confidence intervals for proportions are exact binomial intervals
Energies were calculated with FoldX 5.1 using default parameters
detail: FoldX is licensed separately and not redistributed, so no test here can re-run it; the run vectors are the only in-repo evidence

claim: Seven systems used experimental complex structures and seven used AlphaFold 3 models
detail: the canonical records one structure_source per variant, not a system-level experimental/predicted split that can be counted to 7 and 7 without re-deriving the mapping the manuscript table states

claim: The tier's context score is multiplied by 0.7 between pLDDT 50 and 70 and by 0.4 below 50
detail: the attenuation is applied upstream of the canonical and no column preserves the pre-attenuation context score, so the multiplier cannot be recovered from shipped data

claim: pLDDT 50 admits an axis and 70 upgrades its confidence to high
detail: site_plddt_status summarises PER-AXIS admission decisions and those decisions are not preserved as columns, so the rule cannot be re-derived row by row; the weaker floor and crystal-exemption properties are tested instead

claim: Within-system permutation tests used exact convolved hypergeometric distributions
detail: the permutation machinery lives in verification/stress_tests.py and is exercised by its own gate; no independent implementation exists here to compare against
